tei:div.tei:p: 399)chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs myur 'jug bdud rtsi'i thig pa smin grol lam bzang bzhugs so: na mo dz+nyā na ḍā ki ye: sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'dud: gang zhig thar pa'i grong 'jug phyir: rnal 'byor lam gyi 'jug chos ni: snying po bla ma'i rnal 'byor bstan: dad dang mos gus drag po yis: na mo: bde gshegs kun 'dus bla ma rnal 'byor mar: byang chub snying po'i bar du skyabs su mchi: ma gyur 'gro kun sangs rgyas la 'god phyir: smon 'jug don dam byang chub sems bskyed do: lan gsum gyis rgyud sbyangs nas: skyo shas drag pos 'di skad brjod: āḥ bdag nyid tha mal gnas pa'i spyi gtsug tu: ma chags pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng: skyabs kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rje: dga' chen bde chen bde ba'i rdo rje ni: dkar gsal zhal gcig spyan gsum dbyings su gzigs: phyag gnyis g.yas pas gri gug mkha' la 'phyar: gnyis snang kun rtog 'khrul pa dbyings su gcod: phyag g.yon thod pa khrag bkang thugs kar 'dzin: dpa' bo dgyes bskang mkha' 'gro dbang 400)du sdud: dbu skra zur phud mthon mthing gtsug g.yu mdzes: rigs lnga'i dbang rtags dar dpyangs cod pan 'phur: nyon drug gnas dag rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol: 'dod yon ma spangs dar dang rin chen spras: skyon bral puṇ+ḍa ri ka'i do shal 'phyangs: zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gar gyis rol: nu 'bur bha ga rgyas shing lang tsho ldan: bcu drug dga' ba'i bzhin ngoms yid 'phrog ma: 'khor 'das mnyam rol bde ba chen po'i sku: ye shes 'ja' 'od lnga ldan 'khyil klong bzhugs: spyi bor bla ma rigs kyi bdag po ni: rnal 'byor pradz+nyā rasmi he ru ka: sku mdog dkar dmar zhi ma khro 'dzum ldan: zhal gcig spyan gnyis 'bru tshugs dbyings su gzigasaḥ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga nam mkhar 'phyar: g.yon pas mnyam bzhag bhan thod bdud rtsi 'dzin:

dbu skra thor cog lhag ma sku rgyab 'phyangs: rus rgyan sgom thag brtul zhugs cha lugs rdzogs: zhabs gnyis rol stabs thabs shes pad zlar bzhugs: snang stong dbyer med rdo rje'i sku ru bzhengs: bde gshegs rgyal kun thugs dgongs ma bcos pa: gnyis 401)med dam tshig ye shes dbyer med gyur: kyai: rnam dag spros bral chos sku yi ngo bo: rang gsal lhun grub longs sku yi rang bzhin: 'khrul med thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul gyi rol gar: sku bzhi'i bdag nyid mtshungs med kyi bla ma: skyon bral yon tan kun 'byung gi gter mdzod: bla med bla ma ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol: dus gsum 'gyur med gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: snang srid sna tshogs blo yis blangs te 'bul: so byang sngags kyi dam nyams mthol zhing bshags: rnam dag dge tshogs kun la rjes yi rangs: gang 'dul zab rgya'i chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs: dge kun 'gro ba sems can yongs la bsngo: rang gzhan gdod ma'i gzhi ru sangs rgyas shog: kye kye bla ma rin po che: 'di phyi'i re ltos khyed las med: mgon med bdag la thugs rjes gzigs: bdag rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol: blo ldog bzhi yis rgyud 'byongs shing: dben rir gtan srid zin pa dang: rim gnyis lam mchog mngon gyur nas: ye shes rang zhal mjal bar shog: 402)mchog thun dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ gu ru badz+ra dz+nyā na ḍā ki ni su kha sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: brgya stong khri 'bum gsol ba thob: thun mtshams dbang bzhi blang ba ni: āḥ rigs bdag bla ma'i gnas bzhi'i 'khor lor las: 'od 'phros rang gi gnas bzhir thim pa yis: sgrib pa bzhi dag sku bzhi'i sa bon thebs: don gnyis lhun grub dngos grub bdag thob gyur: kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: spyi bo'i bla ma mkha' 'gro 'od zhu nas:

snying dbus thim pas sgo gsum dag smin rdzogs: mi rtog ye shes chen po'i ngang nyid du: chos nyid mtha' bral gnyug ma'i klong du āḥ zhes brjod cing bsam brjod bral ba'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag nas rjes thob snang srid bla ma'i lam khyer la bslab par bya'o// sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter spyi srung mas gnyer gyis shigaḥ brda thim: : zhes pa 'di yang dge btsun sangs rgyas bzang pos yang yang nan cher bskul ngor/ mdo med 'chol mo 'du shes gsum pa mkha' spyod bde skyong dbang mos bris pa'o//
